general_cs_errors.where: Hold thrust to climb and tilt to fly sideways
general_cs_errors.claim: Let go of thrust to sink gently.
general_cs_errors.problem: Stopping a real drone's thrust does not ensure a gentle descent. Clearly label this as a game control, including in the matching landing instructions and tips.
general_cs_errors.fix: Game controls: hold thrust to climb and tilt to fly sideways. Release thrust for a gentle game landing.

hard_for_8yo.text: A heavier drone needs more thrust, so the battery empties faster. Full payload cuts flight time by about a third.
hard_for_8yo.simpler: A heavier drone needs more lift, so its battery runs out sooner. Carrying the heaviest allowed load cuts flying time by about a third.

hard_for_8yo.text: `reseed/logistics.py`: endurance = 22 min × (1 − 0.35 × payload / 900 g); plans keep a 25 % battery reserve. (Game version: time runs faster.)
hard_for_8yo.simpler: `reseed/logistics.py`: flight time starts at 22 minutes and drops by 35% with a full 900 g load. Plans save a quarter of the battery. (Game version: time runs faster.)

hard_for_8yo.text: Always save enough battery to fly home. Real autopilots have a **Return to Launch (RTL)** mode that flies home by itself.
hard_for_8yo.simpler: Always save enough battery to fly home. Many drones have a **Return to Launch (RTL)** setting that guides them back to where they took off.

safety_or_tone.problem: This gives children direct advice to maneuver near power lines and moving birds, rather than keep a safe distance.
safety_or_tone.fix: 💡 These are game obstacles! Real pilots stay well away from power lines and birds instead of squeezing through gaps.

safety_or_tone.where: This valley has tall trees, busy birds and power lines
safety_or_tone.problem: Finding gaps between these hazards is presented as a safe real-world flying strategy.
safety_or_tone.fix: This game valley has trees, birds and power lines. In real life, choose a clear flying area far from these hazards!

safety_or_tone.where: Big storm coming! Two seed packs for two patches
safety_or_tone.problem: The mission encourages continuing flight into dangerous weather without distinguishing game challenges from safe real-world behavior.
safety_or_tone.fix: Game-only storm challenge! Two seed packs, two patches and checkpoints. Real pilots land before storms arrive.

safety_or_tone.where: Rain makes us heavier and the gusts are strong
safety_or_tone.problem: The encouragement reinforces flying through rain and strong gusts rather than landing.
safety_or_tone.fix: Game rain and strong gusts! Real pilots would land safely and wait for better weather.

safety_or_tone.where: Fly in the dark with a tight battery
safety_or_tone.problem: This frames a small battery margin as an exciting flying goal, undermining the card's reserve-battery lesson.
safety_or_tone.fix: Game night flight: save enough battery to get home

verdict: The supplied ReSeed excerpt establishes no clear factual contradiction, but the game needs explicit game-only framing for its descent controls and hazardous flying challenges.
